entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence analysis: 768 aa, estimated mass 84.15 kDa and theoretical pI 6.34.
Pfam detected tRNA_synt_2_TM at residues 31–253, LPG_synthase_C at 271–569, and tRNA_anti-codon at 697–767.
Sequence-search hits reached 40.4–43.8% identity and 95.7–98.2% query coverage, but no hit passed annotation-transfer filters.
Combined membrane-associated and tRNA-synthetase-like domains suggest an MprF-like lysyl-phosphatidylglycerol synthase; this is an inference, not a direct annotation.
